objective: Continuously reduce repeated manual work, repeated repository reads, redundant validation, and duplicated QA without weakening correctness gates.
startup: Run tools/start-pipeline-task.mjs for the task category.
Review HIGH auto-optimization suggestions before beginning repetitive manual work.
autonomousRules: HIGH optimization suggestions that do not require image generation, user preference, or risky product behavior changes may be added to the ledger and implemented without asking the user.
If the same MANUAL_OVERRIDE reason appears twice, create a reusable tool/workflow extension before a third repetition.
Prefer cached/precomputed project context over repeatedly re-reading the same source files when freshness/digest is valid.
Prefer incremental validation for normal pushes; use full validation for PRs or product/audio/chart/runtime changes.
Never trade away required visual QA, rejected-asset safety, limb correctness, or contiguous runtime completion gates for speed.
Record each autonomous optimization with rationale, output, validation evidence, and whether it changes correctness coverage.
If the same character QA failure occurs twice, automatically replace the retry method instead of repeating the same prompt/edit path.
Prefer local repair when only one region fails; full regeneration is reserved for candidates that fail identity/camera/core-registration.
protectedGates: full validation when classifier requires it
